referees.quote: The current submission cannot be published in its current form for two major reasons
the manuscript might potentially be published provided that the authors gives precise answers to my previous comments.

note: First round is Version 0; the file shows no sign of a transfer from another journal. R1 is read as major revision because they named two major reasons blocking publication: a full rationalisation against White et al. [16] and a clearer case for homogeneous melting, possibly with new grain-size measurements. R2 is read as minor revision because they called the data high quality and asked for clarifications, a Lindemann estimate, longer-delay data and error bars. Both referees recommended publication in Version 1.
